label: PF Backlog 548
title: C16: Fail-safe behaviour policy (+ controlled security-policy improvement, never model-autonomous)
body:
## Problem / why
Security services can fail; policy changes must not be model-driven.
## Acceptance criteria
Per-capability failure policy (PII/authz unavailable -> FAIL CLOSED; audit unavailable for high-risk -> DO NOT EXECUTE; model gateway -> retry/fallback); policy changes go evidence->analysis->candidate->review->test->approve->versioned->deploy.
